sections.title: About per-sulii
sections.body: Modern aesthetic medicine has come a long way, and it can transform skin quickly But when treatments aren't done by a physician the results aren't always right And skin that's been over-treated, again and again, can start to look unnatural From that point of view, plenty of people who skip clinical treatments still want to look naturally beautiful That's why per-sulii developed V-essence and S-essence, a duo formulated to nurture great skin at home V-essence and S-essence are led by experts with international R&D backgrounds Carefully selected peptides, a formula refined through serious research Conditions skin and reduces photosensitivity damage — no retinoic acid, retinal, or retinol Use V first, then S every day And let your skin quietly become more beautiful, naturally

sections.title: The per-sulii Duo
sections.body: per-sulii V-essence (Bee Peptide PLUS) Fades fine lines, refines pores, firms skin — safe and natural per-sulii S-essence (Premium Exosomes + Multi-Peptides) Softens, brightens, and refines skin texture — safe and natural

sections.title: per-sulii, in Pursuit of Bare-Faced Beauty
sections.body: Bare-faced beauty is beauty with real charm The per-sulii duo doesn't change your skin's structure — it conditions your skin Suitable for men, women, and teens (recommended for ages 12+) Nurture bare-faced beauty at home, with ease

sections.title: TAIWAN Science
sections.body: The per-sulii team is led by research experts who previously held senior R&D roles at international pharmaceutical companies Committed to rigorous, safe formulas, produced under Taiwan's quality GMP process Made for those pursuing natural, bare-faced beautyper-suliiMade in Taiwan
